description.value: The Inn at Big White is a hotel accommodation option situated within Big White Ski Resort, one of BC's largest mountain resorts located in the Okanagan highlands east of Kelowna. The resort operates in both winter and summer seasons, with summer offerings including eBike tours, fat biking trails, Nordic activities, and on-mountain dining. A touring cyclist staying here would be at a full-service mountain resort with shuttle transport, wellness services, and a range of dining options on site.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is the Big White Ski Resort site and confirms the Inn at Big White is a real hotel within the resort. All subpages carry a banner stating 'The resort is closed until July 1' — this is a seasonal closure, not a permanent one, and the resort has summer operations (eBike tours, mountain biking, etc. are listed). The website content is almost entirely navigation menus with no amenity-specific detail for the Inn itself; the only cyclist-relevant amenity confirmable from OSM tags is internet_access=wlan, but since the website does not explicitly confirm Wi-Fi it remains unverified per the rules.
concerns: Website content at time of fetch shows a resort-wide seasonal closure banner ('closed until July 1, no public access permitted') — this is a known seasonal pattern for ski resorts, not a permanent closure, but cyclists should verify the inn is open before visiting outside of ski or summer season windows.

The fetched URL resolves to the broader Big White Resort site with heavy navigation menus; no Inn-specific amenity detail was present in the retrieved content, leaving most amenity fields unverifiable.
Wi-Fi is indicated by OSM tag internet_access=wlan but could not be confirmed from website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel within a major BC mountain resort with confirmed summer seasons including cycling-related activities. Seasonal closure (until July 1) is normal and not grounds for exclusion.
